content: When comparing RGB to robot feedback, validate elapsed camera time against host monotonic receipt time; do not assume a per-frame Unix-to-monotonic offset remains correct after a host-clock step. Preserve original exports and labels when repairing correspondence.
applicability: Current RGB-only Piper recordings with continuous30fps camera global timestamps and recorded host epoch/monotonic pairs; device-clock resets are outside the accepted method
count_unit: Two corrected capture checks (task and independent read-only); one observed defective task export. Not robot task counts.
known_limits: Initial epoch/exposure offset not independently measured
No claim about physical insertion cause
No new collection cost or reliability result
